Shanghai Municipal Council.
July 24th 191⁶.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

Sir,
A meeting convened by the Shanghai Journalists Association was held in the International Institute at 3 p.m. 22nd inst for the purpose of bidding farewell to the Parliamentarians before they leave for the capital. Wu Ting Fang, Huang Hsing, Nyou Tih Sung Pah Vung Wei 柏文蔚 Ho Hai King 何海鳴 and all the leading journalists of Shanghai were present. Each of the persons named made a short speech referring to the present condition of the country and the steps to be taken to make it prosperous.
Five members of Parliament left the S.N.R. Station for Peking at 11 p.m. 22nd inst.
The Fokien residents in Shanghai held a meeting in their guild in Foochow Road on 23rd inst for the purpose of deciding ways and means to oppose the armament policy of the present Tutuh of Fokien who is recruiting soldiers in the north and buying ammunition. After several speeches were made explaining the situation the meeting decided to send telegrams to the Central Government advising it to restrain the chief officer of Fokien from his war like policy. They also decided to send a telegram to the Tutuh himself counselling him to desist from unpopular acts.
Li Ping Shu 李平書 is now living at No.1 Admiral Bayle. He intends to enlist a bodyguard.
The small shops in the vicinity of the Arsenal have sent a petition to General Yang complaining of the failure of the soldiers to pay their debts.
The Japanese Consul General and General Aoki entertained Dr. Sun Yat Sen , General Huang Hsing and other politicians to a dinner at the Japanese Club Boone Road at 7 p.m. 22nd inst. This dinner was given in return for one which was given by General Huang Hsing and Dr. Sun Yat Sen to which Japanese officials were invited.
Six Chinese members of Parliament left for Peking by the 11 p.m. train on July 23rd.

Your Obedient Servant,
mmmmmusthoma
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

470
24/7/16
上海工部局。
191⁶年7月24日。

（印：上海工部局）
警务处，
（侦探股）

先生：
上海记者协会于本月22日下午3时在国际学会召开了一次会议，目的是在议员们启程前往首都之前为他们送行。伍廷芳、黄兴、钮永建、宋教仁、柏文蔚、何海鸣以及上海所有主要记者均出席了会议。上述人士每人均作了简短发言，谈及国家现状及为实现繁荣应采取的措施。
五名议员于本月22日晚11时离开沪宁铁路车站前往北京。
在沪福建居民于本月23日在福州路的会馆举行会议，旨在商讨对策，以反对现任福建督军招募士兵并在北方购买弹药的扩军政策。在经过数人发言解释局势后，会议决定向中央政府发送电报，建议其约束福建主官的黩武政策。他们还决定向督军本人发送电报，劝其停止不得人心的举动。
李平书现居住于贝勒路1号。他打算招募一支保镖队伍。
兵工厂附近的小商店已向杨将军递交请愿书，投诉士兵拖欠债务不还。
日本总领事和青木将军于本月22日晚7时在布恩路日本俱乐部宴请孙中山博士、黄兴将军及其他政客。此次晚宴是为了回请此前由黄兴将军和孙中山博士举办并邀请日本官员参加的宴会。
六名中国议员于7月23日晚11时乘火车前往北京。

您顺从的仆人，
mmmmmusthoma
首席探长。

警察总监上尉。

Shanghai Municipal Police.
Confidential
Hongkew Station.
July 23rd 191 6.
REPORT ON Dr Sun Yet Sun and General Huang Hsing.
Made by D.S.I.Reeves.    Forwarded by
Sir,
Detective Nakai reports to me this morning that the Japanese
Consul General, and General Aoki and other Chinese Politicians are entertaining Dr Sun Yet Sun
and General Huang Hsing to a dinner at the Japanese Club, Boone Rd
at 7.P.M. 22nd inst. This dinner was given in return for one
which was given by General Huang Hsing and Dr Sun Yet Sun to which Japanese
officials were invited.
I am Sir,
Your obedient servant.
Syd. M. Reeves
D.S.I.

1916年7月23日。
关于孙逸仙博士和黄兴将军的报告。
由侦探副督察里夫斯（Reeves）撰写。    呈递
先生：
中井（Nakai）侦探今晨向我报告称，日本总领事、青木将军及其他中国政客将于本月22日晚7时在布恩路日本俱乐部宴请孙逸仙博士和黄兴将军。此次晚宴是为了回请此前由黄兴将军和孙逸仙博士举办并邀请日本官员参加的宴会。
先生，我是
您顺从的仆人。
西德尼·M·里夫斯（Syd. M. Reeves）
侦探副督察
